reviewItem.question: For "Breaking Changes: Kyverno version 1.13 contains the following breaking configuration changes: To upgrade to 1.13 and continue to allow wildcard view…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Upgrading to Kyverno 1.13 changes configuration handling so that PolicyExceptions can no longer be configured in all namespaces by default: to continue allowing exceptions in all namespaces, the Helm value features.policyExceptions.namespace must be set to `*`, although limiting exceptions to a specific namespace is recommended.
